items.headline: Malachi Singleton passes for 267 yards and rushes for a TD to lead App State past ECU 27-24
items.description: — Malachi Singleton passed for 267 yards and had one of three Appalachian State rushing touchdowns as the Mountaineers beat East Carolina 27-24 on Saturday for their fourth straight win in the series.
